mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past two months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increase over 2 months does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decrease > 1% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 0.25% does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increase and PAYEMS decrease do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decrease in housing starts (HOUST) during a period of economic expansion signals a potential slowdown in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decrease during economic expansion does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of decreasing industrial production (INDPRO) and increasing unemployment (UNRATE) signals a supply-demand imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decrease and UNRATE increase do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
